steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as required for this case.
Enable the eRFX project capability required by the case.
Navigate from the summary to the comparison grid before entering awarding.
Open the awarding page for the prepared closed event.
Confirm the awarding page exposes the fullscreen control.
Enter fullscreen mode for the awarding grid.
Verify fullscreen mode is active and the grid-only view is shown.
Open the hidden-fields control on the fullscreen awarding grid.
Assert that the hidden-fields menu lists the eight hidden columns.

args.goal: on the fullscreen awarding grid, reopen the hidden-fields control, tick one listed hidden column, and stop when that column is visibly added to the grid

steps.note: Reveal a dynamic hidden column and verify the grid updates after it is ticked.
Confirm the grid remains in fullscreen mode after revealing the hidden column.
